params.name: borrower_name
params.description: Filter loans by borrower name (prefix match against the borrower or co-borrower first or last name).

params.name: closing_date_end
params.description: Filter to loans with a closing date on or before this date (inclusive).

params.name: closing_date_start
params.description: Filter to loans with a closing date on or after this date (inclusive).

params.name: in_los
params.description: Filter loans by whether they are synced to the LOS.

params.name: is_active
params.description: Filter loans by active status (default true).

params.name: loan_number
params.description: Filter loans by exact loan number.

params.name: loan_officer_id
params.description: <<glossary:Loan officer>> ID by which to filter loans.

params.name: loan_purpose
params.description: Loan purpose search parameter by which to filter loans.

params.name: loan_type
params.description: Loan type search parameter by which to filter loans.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort by creation date: "asc" (oldest first, default) or "desc" (newest first).

params.name: org_id
params.description: Organization (company, region, or branch) ID by which to filter loans.

params.name: user_borrower_id
params.description: User borrower ID by which to filter loans.

params.name: page
params.description: The page to retrieve.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of records returned in each page.

params.name: created_after
params.description: The date which a resource must be created after to be returned.

params.name: created_before
params.description: The date which a resource must be created before to be returned.

params.name: updated_after
params.description: The date which a resource must be updated after to be returned.

params.name: updated_before
params.description: The date which a resource must be updated before to be returned.
